Human-in-the-loop login provisioning (headed browser)

positional arguments:
  site             Site name or signup URL (omit with --all/--sites)

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --sites SITES    Comma-separated site names/URLs to provision in a loop
  --all            Provision ALL needs_human sites in a loop
  --config CONFIG  Source config path (default: search both)
  --serve          Serve the localhost control API instead of prompting in the
                   terminal
  --port PORT      Control API port on 127.0.0.1 (default 8778)
